title: Failure in a query state
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let a query state consist of an optional active family of subsets of the $n$ coordinates and a finite trace of estimate records, let the target be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube, and let $	au$ be a rational threshold in $(0,1]$. The state has a failure if its trace contains a record for which the absolute difference between its estimate and the restricted Fourier weight of the target, at the record's coordinates and frequency prefix, is at least $	au^2/4$.
hypotheses_covered: A query state with an optional active family and a finite trace
A Boolean target function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
